test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On: 2 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is Conscientous.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of 'Conscientous' according to the English dictionary is 'C**onscientious**'.
 
• The word 'Conscientious' means '**careful to do something correctly and well**'.
 
 
• Example: *He’s a conscientious worker.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate answer is 'Conscientous'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• Let's understand the meaning of other options.

 
 
• **Inscrutable**- not showing any emotions and therefore difficult to understand or know.
 
• **Banality**- the fact or condition of being banal; unoriginality.
 
• **Giddyap**- command (as to a horse) to go ahead or go faster.
